scripts.dev: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 3002,3003,8000 } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; pnpm --parallel --filter ./apps/docs --filter ./apps/http-server --filter ./apps/ws-backend run dev"
